name: spooky-plate
effect: Held: Increases the power of the holder’s Ghost moves by 20%. Held by a Multitype Pokémon: Holder’s type becomes Ghost.
short_effect: Held: Ghost-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Changes Arceus’s and Judgment’s type to Ghost.

flavor_text.black-white: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Ghost-type moves.
flavor_text.black-2-white-2: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Ghost-type moves.
